A '''base''' [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[YIN-762]] of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The buildings in the base included a [[command center]], an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], multiple [[Autoturret/Legends|turrets]], and processing centers for the resources available in and around the base. During the [[Invasion of Spinnaker|invasion]] of the nearby [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] sent [[Neimoidian trader]]s to YIN-762's base to trade for [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]].

==Description==
A base was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. It was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the [[B1-series battle droid|B1 battle droid]] [[YIN-762]] and attended to by four [[OX9]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]], who gathered [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] from artificial [[Farm/Legends|farms]] and harvested [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] from [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. The base was near the southeastern side of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] and northeast of another Naboo [[Unidentified Naboo village (OOM-9)|village]]. The base was surrounded by trees with only one entrance in the northwest.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Spinnaker_main.png|thumb|right|300px|YIN-762's base was located near the city Spinnaker (pictured).]]
The entrance was defended by a light [[Autoturret/Legends|turret]] and held a [[nova processing center]] used for storing [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] from nearby deposits. The base was led from a [[command center]] that was adjacent to two farms, a [[food processing center]], a [[power core]], and a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. The southwestern side was bordered by a [[Water/Legends|river]] on which lay an aquatic [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]] guarded by a light [[Turret/Legends|turret]]. The northern area of the base included an [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-air turret]] and a [[carbon processing center]]. The northeastern portion held an [[animal nursery]], another light turret, and an [[ore processing center]] near several ore deposits.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
The base was established in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] during the Trade Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="GB" /> While preparing to [[Invasion of Spinnaker|invade]] Spinnaker, the B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] captured the village near Spinnaker, from which he assembled [[Neimoidian trader]]s, a type of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], to trade nova crystals with the spaceport in YIN-762's base. In doing so, OOM-9 was able to reach [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] goal of extorting 10,000 nova crystals during the invasion of Spinnaker.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
YIN-762's base was created for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> which was released on [[November 11]], [[2001]].<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> Prior to its appearance in the game, the base was first mentioned in [[Prima Games]]' accompanying [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima" /> released [[November 7|four days]] earlier.<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> In the game, the base appeared in the third level of the Trade Federation campaign, "Spinnaker's Spoils."<ref name="GB" />
